_readme: Canonical Standard-vocabulary and fixed export recipe contract. Five consumers assert it: src/lib/standard-mapping.test.ts (desktop style/loudness), src/lib/standard-export.test.ts (desktop delivery recipe), apps/iphone-native/rust/src/lib.rs (iPhone bridge style/delivery/clamp), apps/android-native/rust/src/lib.rs (Android bridge style/delivery/clamp), and apps/iphone-native/YESMasterNativeTests/NativeLoudnessTests.swift (Swift style/loudness resource). Change this file and all consumers together.
